source: Bundled QuantStart adjusted archive; see data/manifest.json
assumptions: Signals through prior close; idealized fills at next adjusted open with 10 bp adverse slippage (rounded tick) and 10 bp fees per side. 10% per asset / 30% gross / $10,000 capital cap, 8% per-position stop, 3% daily loss and latched 10% drawdown entry halt. Protective orders are limit orders; historical fills are assumed, not guaranteed. Benchmark holds initial 10% whole-unit allocation per asset and remaining cash. Both liquidate at final close. Production scheduled polling does not guarantee opening prices; no cash interest/taxes/liquidity model.
